skill_id.description: Unique namespaced identifier for the skill (e.g. system.status, storage.plan).

version.description: Semantic version of the skill contract.

category.description: Execution classification: READ (side-effect free), PROPOSE (dry-run simulation producing plan hash), MUTATE (state-altering/destructive requiring approval).

description.description: Detailed description of what the skill evaluates or mutates.

invariants_required.description: List of formal security invariants required before this skill may execute.

approval_gate_required.description: Whether execution by an AI agent requires human engineer approval.

inputs_schema.description: JSON Schema validating all input parameters.

outputs_schema.description: JSON Schema validating all output fields.
